text: The Pullman car back to London
why: ¶215 says the group had a Pullman car corner to themselves that evening as they whirled back to London.

text: The evening of the race, in a Pullman car back to London
why: ¶183 places the race at Winchester, and ¶215 says 'that evening' for the Pullman car journey back to London.

text: Holmes's account of the Monday night
why: ¶215 says the travellers listened to Holmes's narrative of the events of the Monday night at the Dartmoor stables.
Madame Lesurier appears only as the issuer of a milliner's bill (¶84). The story never gives her any account or statement of events, so this label implies testimony the story has not supplied.
